scope: bounded paired protected-mode stack-segment limit fault and in-range control

observations.outside_ss_limit: An authored 32-bit EBP-based dword read uses a present writable SS with limit 0x1fff and EBP=0x2100. ESP=0x1800 leaves the 16-byte #SS frame at 0x17f0..0x17ff inside the limit. QEMU entered the vector-12 handler with error 0 and fault EIP at the read, unchanged target RAM and general registers, then reloaded wide SS and retried once to completion. Frozen DOSBox-X completed the out-of-limit read with SS=0x18 and no handler marker. This is a reference divergence, not paired parity.
observations.in_range_control: With the same small SS but EBP=0x1000, both engines completed the read with no handler marker and the expected target value.
observations.test_harness: Both fixture variants were assembled from authored source. The final native test pins the observed DOSBox-X completion path; temporary diagnostic property warnings were removed before the accepted run.
